title: Software company build and delivery platform

organisation.name: Brindle Systems
organisation.summary: Brindle Systems builds a hosted observability product. Developers sign in with SSO and push to source control; jobs run on self-hosted CI runners on Kubernetes that fetch packages through an internal mirror, read build secrets from a secrets vault, sign images with a keyless signing service and push them to an artifact registry. A GitOps controller watches the configuration repository and deploys signed images to the production cluster. Developer laptops run EDR, and the SIEM collects EDR alerts and the production cluster's audit log.
